text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I head to the shopping district on my
day off.
While there, I hear some kind of
commotion
unfolding.

text_block_list.name: Bento Store Owner
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe I made such a huge
error... There's
no way I'll be able to use up all
this rice! What
should I do?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, that sounds tough. But don't
beat
yourself up. Everyone makes
mistakes, you know.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We just need to think outside the box!
And I
know just the thing!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
First, we put up a poster... Okay, there
we go!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Greetings! Get your boxed lunches here!
Only
500 yen! And for just 100 yen
more, you'll get
double the rice!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And there's nothing wrong with it, by
the way!
You can eat it with total peace
of mind! ♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, isn't that Pearl over there? She's
selling...
bentos?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Wow, we get that much for that price?
What a
deal! ♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! We were just thinking of having
lunch!
Super size me, por favor!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! ♪ One super size bento,
coming right
up!

text_block_list.name: Bento Store Owner
text_block_list.text:
Wow. I can't believe how much rice the

Umamusume students are buying!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, broadening your horizons opens
up all
kinds of possibilities. Never give
up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I leave the shopping district, touched by
what I've
seen. However...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later on,
as I arrive at the shopping mall, I notice
an incredibly detailed
mannequin. It almost looks
alive...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It... even breathes? I do a double take,
and then I
realize...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué?! Pearl?! What are you doing here?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Th-that was... quite the shock.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ho, ho, ho. ♪ We meet again.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Actually, my friend working in retail
accidentally broke a mannequin, so now
I'm working part-time
as a temporary
mannequin.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You can do that?! I've never heard of a
job like
that!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The world works in mysterious ways. Ah,
but since
I'm a mannequin, I should
really stay quiet. ♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Sh-she really is quiet.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Um, well, we don't want to get in your
way, so
we'll be leaving now. See you,
Pearl.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Pearl, you were so amazing today! Do
you always
spend your days off like
that?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I do. You see, I don't want anyone
to
squander their potential.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's why I lead through action. "As
long as you
don't give up, a path will
reveal itself." That's my
motto!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I just can't help buying into
everything
Pearl says.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I've received thank-you messages
from the
two people I helped today.
How sweet! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl believes in the power
of never
giving up. And it looks like she
holds herself to
that principle too.
